description: Estimates the market value in ILS of a specific small or mid-sized business in Israel, from its industry, annual revenue and annual pre-tax profit. Use this when someone asks what an Israeli business is worth or what price is fair for it: an owner selling or setting an asking price, a partner leaving or being bought out, a buyer checking whether an asking price makes sense, an accountant or broker preparing a number for a client, a bank or investor asking, or a divorce or inheritance that includes a business. Typical requests: "כמה שווה העסק שלי", "כמה לבקש על המסעדה", "הערכת שווי לעסק", "השותף רוצה לצאת, כמה לשלם לו", "מבקשים 800 אלף על בית הקפה, זה הוגן?", "what is my cafe in Tel Aviv worth". Covers restaurants and cafes, retail, professional services, clinics, beauty and barbershops, construction trades, education, logistics, events and tech services. Not for public companies, real estate, startups priced on a funding round, or businesses outside Israel. A profit range (annualProfitMin/annualProfitMax) works when exact profit is unknown. Returns the likely value, a low-high range, a confidence level, a Hebrew summary, the follow-up questions that would tighten the number, and a link to the full calculation on esek-shave.co.il. Method: Israeli industry multiples on owner profit (SDE), cross-checked with a revenue multiple, adjusted for owner salary, years in business and debt.

annualProfit.description: Annual pre-tax profit in ILS. Negative for a loss. If the owner only knows a rough range, send the midpoint here and the bounds in annualProfitMin / annualProfitMax.

annualProfitMax.description: Optional. Upper bound of annual profit when the owner only knows a range.

annualProfitMin.description: Optional. Lower bound of annual profit when the owner only knows a range (e.g. 100000 for "100-200 thousand").

annualRevenue.description: Annual revenue (turnover) in ILS, e.g. 2400000. If the owner gives a monthly figure, multiply by 12.

industry.description: Industry, Hebrew name (e.g. מזון ומסעדנות) or English alias (restaurant, retail, clinic, dentist, services, accounting, tech, construction, plumber, beauty, salon, education, logistics, events, other). Send "other" if nothing fits.

loansBalance.description: Outstanding loans and supplier debt in ILS (optional, deducted). 0 = no debt.

ownerSalary.description: Annual salary the business pays the owner as an expense (company / בע"מ only), in ILS. It is added back to profit. For a sole proprietor (עוסק) the profit already includes the owner's earnings: send 0 or omit.

yearsActive.description: Optional. Years the business has been operating. If unknown, omit it: the estimate treats age as neutral and lists it as a follow-up question.
